# v0.1.12 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.12. The capability version is 12.

Refused pull request runs post their refusal status before a worker
is selected. Worker readiness reports an unavailable runner image as
not ready. The worker socket timeout is configurable.

Check records written before a run's progress are accepted. Poll
state tracks disk usage incrementally instead of walking the whole
state directory on every submit and prune.

Failed poll submissions retry with a distinct idempotent key. Setup
failures map to neutral checks. A merge refused because the base
branch moved posts an error status, and a merge is built on the
moved base.

Writers may change workflows under the PR workflow flag. A configured
job that the workflow at a commit does not define is skipped instead
of failing the run.

The terminal dashboard keeps raw rows aligned. Stored run logs
display as terminal data: carriage returns and control bytes no
longer drive the terminal.

Design and investigation documents for managed runners, scheduling,
shared caches, capacity, and the CI dashboard are added. They
describe proposals, not shipped behavior.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This file does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
